exposure: bilateral balloon occlusion of the common iliac arteries (CIA)
cohort: 52 women with confirmed placental accretism who underwent caesarean section
finding: The study did not find a significant difference in blood loss or blood product requirement between women who underwent bilateral balloon occlusion of the common iliac arteries during caesarean section for placenta accreta compared to those who did not.
mod_finding: The study investigated the use of bilateral balloon occlusion of the common iliac arteries prior to caesarean section in cases of placenta accretism but did not compare different modes of delivery.
